text:
kat (Marketing): Quick creative brief  need a compact benchmark promo pack for webinar + inbound. Single-sheet that scales to hero, email header, and social tile.

joel (Design): What crops + exports? motion needed?

kat (Marketing): desktop 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800. svg master + png @2x. tiny 3-frame sparkline GIF (320x80) for ads. also transparent PNG for overlays.

teri (Growth): Add a brand-only/no-CTA variant for lift tests and a plain-text CTA list for ad platforms. Audience: devs (latency) vs buyers (cost). We'll A/B CTAs.

joel (Design): Plan two layout systems: stat-led (big number + sparkline) and sentence-led (short line + supporting stat). Two colorways: brand blue + inverted dark. Modular badge slot for "Dedicated" or "SLA".

kat (Marketing): Messaging lanes: latency-first and cost-first. Headlines ~6 words, subheads ~1216 words. Pull conservative numbers from sheet "inbound-bench-nov".

amy (Legal): Quick compliance flag: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or "always". Use qualifiers: "up to" or "on typical workloads". Add a tiny methodology footnote (link). I can review final copy quickly.

joel (Design): Timeline: draft mocks by tomorrow 11:00, review at 11:30, final package by EOD Wed. Deliverables: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways x 3 crops + GIF + svg animation + transparent PNG + copy_slate.txt + README.

assets-bot: uploaded draft_pack_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/benchmark-pack/draft_pack_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, copy_slate.txt, README).

teri (Growth): Also request a variant where the stat is replaced by a 1-line customer quote for CRO tests. And include 1-line alt text for accessibility.

joel (Design): Will include testimonial slot and alt text file. GIF will be subtle 3-frame loop. SVG will include a micro-animation option for the landing page.

kat (Marketing): Please add two headline options per lane and two subhead options. Legal ping Amy when copy is attached.

amy (Legal): Sounds good  ping me when final copy is attached; Ill turn it around in about an hour for short claims.

joel (Design): Figma draft uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/benchpack/mini-hero-drafts (org access). Will update thread with mock v2 link. :sparkles:
